scope: Five explicitly provided source files; tools and MCP disabled. No papers, runtime records or secrets supplied.

findings.reason: Skipping a wrong-kind duplicate claim identity could select an ambiguous source. Existing fail-closed behavior should not be loosened.

Production validator made N+1 identical live scope requests per model send. Batch membership checking now makes one live snapshot check per send, with no cross-call cache; revocation blocks the next call. Optional validator fallback remains for alternate implementations.

Malformed initial or revised verification could contain the same identity in accepted and rejected. Initial conflicts stay rejected; conflicting revisions cannot promote rejected claims or overwrite prior unambiguous acceptance.
Actual graph prepares coverage repair before invoking repair_rejected, passing already-filtered accepted context. Reviewer inferred the reverse order without graph.py.
